name: Beyond the Chrysalis
desc: A longsword brimming with light and color, and as weightless as a butterfly when brandished. It was once used by a certain individual to break bonds.

value.text:
Each time the equipping character uses their Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, they gain one of the following three effects in sequence:
Winds of Devotion: Increases the equipping character's CRIT DMG by <color=#36ffff>56%/72%/88%/104%/120%</color> for 10s;
Winds of Defiance: Increases Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by the equipping character by <color=#36ffff>36%/45%/54%/63%/72%</color> for 10s; and
Winds of Plenty: Regenerates <color=#36ffff>5/5.5/6/6.5/7</color> Elemental Energy for the equipping character. Up to <color=#36ffff>5/5.5/6/6.5/7</color> Elemental Energy can be regenerated in this way every 4s.
The aforementioned effects are removed and the sequence is reset when the equipping character leaves the field.

customize.name: Hymn of the Maelstrom
customize.desc: An exquisite lamp crafted out of blue chalcedony which looks like a treasure right out of a fairy tale. It is said that a song of praise, forgotten by all, slumbers sealed inside this lamp.

customize.name: Breezeborne Refrain
customize.desc: A dark green bow string made out of pure and flawless gemstone. It never fails to summon a warm spring breeze whenever it is drawn.

customize.name: New Bough
customize.desc: A sword made from sacred wood, said to have once turned the tide of battle.

customize.name: Winter's Heavy Heart
customize.desc: A ceremonial artifact formed from the purest ice and snow. Legend has it that generations of Snegovik lords used it in coronation ceremonies until five hundred years ago.

customize.name: Dragon's Bane
customize.desc: A polearm decorated with an entwining golden dragon. Light and sharp, this weapon may very well kill dragons with ease.

customize.name: Favonius Greatsword
customize.desc: A heavy ceremonial sword of the Knights of Favonius. It channels elemental power easily and is highly destructive.

desc.text:
In the days before she lost her last name, the world had known her as "eldest daughter of the Strivozhas."
The Grand Duke Photius had passed away after a sudden stroke, leaving the counselor who had served him faithfully to inherit his title,
While the grand rebellion he had intended to lead with the Druzhna was laid to rest in the grave alongside the mead he had drunk.
Though the winds over the frozen earth were as fickle as ever, the house of the Vila princess remained at the very pinnacle of power.
Against the wishes of the forebear, the Silver Court of Veneter once again fell into the hands of a Strivozha,
Adding yet another tale of loyalty to the lore of that name, as was the case in the court of the Pale Star.
"Oh, great princess, are you really so naive as to believe that the newly crowned Tsaritsa would elect to trust your house?"
"The glory of the court of the Pale Star hangs above her head like a sharp blade. She will eventually succumb to the flattery of humankind."
"Your mother... she, The Pure One, was once so devoted to Tsar Monomakh. How could you have forgotten that oath?"
"Your Highness, O noble Glowatza Strivozha, let us join hands and cast down that usurper who dared lay claim to the throne!"
The rebels sought to win her over to their cause, urging her to rebel against the new sovereign of the snowy wastes, knowing of her mother's unwavering loyalty to the old Tsar.
The eldest daughter of the Strivozhas agreed without hesitation, her emerald eyes gleaming with the same noble compassion that had once shone in her mother's eyes.
"If, as you say, my friend, that contemptible false sovereign must be overthrown for the future of our clan,
Then I shall swear upon the honor of Saint Strivozha: the Vila will stand steadfastly at your side."
Then, just as the rebels had hoped, in the months that followed, the Vila princess would regularly denounce the Tsaritsa's actions in public.
First came the expulsion of the palace-appointed observer from her lands; then came the raising of a following without royal sanction.
Unsurprisingly, the eldest daughter of the Strivozhas had always proven to be every bit as loyal and dependable as her mother, who had been honored as The Pure One.
As such, though wary and distrustful of one another, the rebels of the various fae clans were always willing to entrust their secrets to the Vila, leaving her to devise their plans.
That is, until the rebels were caught in one fell swoop. It was only then that they learned that the ally they had counted on had long since taken her place at the Tsaritsa's side.
The rebels, angered by her betrayal and, in panic, began to rail against her for besmirching her mother's good name. However, they were coolly and swiftly dismissed.
"Ah, did you not previously praise the loyalty of the Strivozhas and, on that very account, seek an alliance with us?
As I said, if Her Majesty ought indeed to be overthrown, the Vila will naturally stand shoulder to shoulder with you in battle.
Except... if the wind has ever carried word to you, then you ought to know that Anastasya alone is our sovereign.
You are not my lieges, and nor am I your vassal. Why, then, are you even accusing me of betraying your rebellion?"
And thus it came to pass that, beneath the benevolent light that shone upon the frozen earth, the rebellion was brought to a complete end.
The Strivozhas were never the enemy of any, and as the histories would record, they upheld their honor and loyalty to the very end.
Here, the tale so finely rendered comes to a close. However, the Vila princess's account of what followed remains little known...
"My Tsaritsa. A noble name is no more than a chain; and the most precious gift to me now is that of freedom.
Since the Vila has already been blessed by Your Majesty's boundless grace, I beseech you to grant me release from this very chain.
Further, my raising of a force without sanction, even if it was done to deceive the rebels, remains an unforgivable act of treason.
I beg Your Majesty to reclaim my fief, strip me of my last name and title, and appoint another in my stead."
And so, a solemn decree descended from the throne on high, its mercy like a distant, ethereal sigh...
"Glowatza. From this day forth, let none remember you by your last name.
In the histories of days to come, your title shall be no more. May your gravestone, in the end, bear witness to the convictions you held so true."

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Rise of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
In the east of the tundra, that arrogant monster born within the wing-like mountain is nothing more than a lowly peddler of malt and minerals.
The Vila under his command are but weaklings with insect wings, while the Domovoy cannot even lift weapons with their stunted arms.
Who would heed the clamor of such rabble? What strength could they possibly have to stand against the onslaught of the kings of Volkodlak?

materials.name: Hollow Root of Life
materials.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
With only a few crystals grown upon it, this branch holds little power and gives off a faint glow.

materials.name: Chimeric Core
materials.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
This is the most fundamental core grown within a man-made monster. Yet, simple as it may be, it contains the primordial design for the growth of all man-made creations.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Muster of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"They seized the canyon by sheer luck. That laughably arrogant fool is no more than a spent bolt, a fading gale."
"Even with all their strength, they can barely hold back a fraction of our forces. Soon enough, their defeat will be plain to see."
"Soldiers, march onward! For our king has already foretold, for this entire campaign shall end in effortless victory!"

materials.name: Sprout Node of Life
materials.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
A branch bearing a fair number of crystals. It feels heavy in the hand, and traces of vitality can still be felt within it even after it has broken away from the Leshy's body.

materials.name: Symbiotic Chimeric Nucleus
materials.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
A relatively complex core harvested from a man-made monster. This symbiotic nucleus is engineered to sustain the biological cycles of two distinct life-forms, seamlessly weaving them into a single organism.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Clarion of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"Our enemy Monomakh has built his palace beyond the valley, a sign that he is fully confident in his ability to contend with us."
"As matters stand, he deserves our utmost caution. Any talk of a swift victory should now be set aside."
"But it matters not. With wisdom to guide us all, the King shall stand with the clans to overcome every hardship and usher in a glorious new era!"

materials.name: Coiled Core of Life
materials.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
A branch with a fully formed crystal core. It contains vitality that will not easily fade. If buried in the soil, it would likely grow into a new Leshy before long.

materials.name: Prime Chimeric Nexus
materials.desc:
The internal core harvested from aberrant man-made monsters.
The most complex core a man-made monster can possibly sustain, serving as an artificially engineered yet flawless seed of life. Whoever brought this creation into life has surely unlocked the very secrets of how life itself is shaped.

materials.name: Triumph of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"All hail the Tsar, Protector of all fae, Heir to the Pale Star, sovereign born of sacred blood!"
"Praise be, for the entire tundra now stands as one beneath the brilliance of the Polestar!"
"Praise be, for His Majesty has slain the false king and embraced all fae. Such is his benevolence, such is his mercy!"
